Prompt for codex:
Read README.md and AGENTS.md in this repository.
Then read and analyze the Nemesis Trade platform and documentation:
https://nemesis.trade
Understand how the protocol works, including:
swaps
long and short positions
liquidity provision
position lifecycle (open, manage, close)
add liquidity
Use this understanding to improve the existing bot.
---
Task
Build a complete Python automation agent for Nemesis Trade testnet.
The agent must simulate realistic trading behavior using 6 wallets.
---
Wallet Setup
Load wallets from .env:
PRIVATE_KEY_1=
PRIVATE_KEY_2=
PRIVATE_KEY_3=
PRIVATE_KEY_4=
PRIVATE_KEY_5=
PRIVATE_KEY_6=
Each wallet must behave independently.
---
Core Behavior
The bot must perform real protocol interactions:
swap tokens
open long positions
open short positions
close positions
add liquidity
remove liquidity
The bot must understand that:
positions must be opened before they can be closed
liquidity must be added before it can be removed
---
Session Logic
Each session:

select random wallet
check balance
if balance < 0.2 ETH → attempt faucet
perform 2–3 different actions
wait random delay
end session
Sessions run multiple times per day.
---
Trading Logic
Trades must be realistic:
small random sizes
mix long and short
do not repeat identical trades
interact with different pools if possible
---
Liquidity Logic
Occasionally:
add liquidity
remove liquidity
Not

small random sizes
mix long and short
do not repeat identical trades
interact with different pools if possible
---
Liquidity Logic
Occasionally:
add liquidity
remove liquidity
Not every session.
---
Randomization
Randomize:
wallet selection
action type
trade size
delay
Delay range:
2 to 45 minutes
---
Activity Limits
Per wallet:
10-20 interactions per day
---
Logging
Log everything:
timestamp
wallet
action

tx hash
status
Save to:
logs/nemesis_agent.log
---
Error Handling
Handle:
RPC errors
failed transactions
insufficient balance
faucet failure
Retry when possible.
---
Goal
Create a working bot that behaves like a real early user of Nemesis Trade
based on how the protocol actually works.
